# Pactile capabilities

Use the smallest applicable capability and honor its declared policy, evidence, and stop conditions.

- `approval-personal` — Keep execution and high-impact actions inside user authorization.
- `close-basic` — Close only after acceptance evidence and boundary checks agree.
- `context-progressive` — Load only the context needed for the next decision.
- `define-basic` — Define a Task deliverable, acceptance, delivery level and dependencies.
- `execute-agent` — Implement the approved change inside the frozen write set.
- `intake-basic` — Scope new work before creating an independently acceptable Task.
- `observability-local` — Record sanitized local execution and decision evidence.
- `verify-basic` — Verify observable behavior at pre-agreed public seams.
<!-- PACTILE:END -->
